ranking_metric: Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package)
uncertainty: Pilot cell: two C paths verified, c-ares and ldns, ranked by Debian popcon sourcemax installations. bind9, unbound and libevent are excluded because they document no public parser for caller-supplied message bytes; knot, udns and getdns remain leads (getdns shares the ldns-derived gldns code). glibc and musl libresolv ns_initparse are recorded as standard/runtime leads and were not run. c-ares and ldns drop the reserved Z bit (z carries AD and CD). Each verified path parses the two valid controls (a query and a response with compressed CNAME/A/AAAA/MX answers) to the hand-written oracle summary, has library source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback that differs between the controls. Two valid controls do not establish EDNS0, DNSSEC, TXT, authority/additional or malformed-input behaviour. Package-level adoption metrics include non-DNS use; the remaining leads are unverified, and the cell is not a definitive top ten.
selection: Three control-verified C DNS path(s), ranked by Debian popcon sourcemax installations (max over binary packages built from the source package): c-ares 1.34.9 (43,027), ldns 1.8.4 (1,240), knot 3.6.2 (483).
